subject: Important Update: Your Flight Reservation Confirmation
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are pleased to inform you that your flight reservation from New York to London has been successfully confirmed for your upcoming business trip. Please find the attached e-ticket for your reference. Kindly review the flight details and ensure all information is correct. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, The Airline Team
